id.description: Stable, monotonically increasing. Generated by ingest; never reused.

sev.description: Severity tier assigned by ingest; see D-003 for thresholds.

summary.description: Optional 1-3 sentence context. Sourced language, not LLM-written.

ts.description: Original event timestamp from source, ms since epoch UTC.

ingestedAt.description: When our ingest saw it, ms since epoch UTC.

confidence.description: D-012: our local estimate of corroboration strength — source quality + distinct reporting outlets + recency. An ESTIMATE about sourcing, never a claim the incident is true.

sources.description: All corroborating article URLs (mirrors top-level sources[]).

outlets.description: Distinct reporting hostnames, in first-seen order.

media.description: D-020 event imagery, populated at ingest time only when the source feed ships an explicit image reference (Media RSS / enclosure) or a resolvable og:image on the article page. image is a same-origin path under public/data/media/ downloaded and size-capped by the ingest service; video_url is an external watch link from yt:videoId, never embedded.

image.description: Same-origin path, relative to the site root. Absent = no verified image; UI must not fabricate one.

video_url.description: External watch link only (yt:videoId from the feed). Never embedded; user leaves the site on click.

geo.description: D-014/D-020: provenance of the event's lat/lon. tier=precise means a real place was resolved; tier=approximate means a representative point is shown (geo.scope says whether country, city or region) and the marker is intentionally approximate, not incident-site accurate. Legacy rows pre-D-014 may lack this object; the client treats absence as approximate.

source.description: Which code path produced the coordinates: source = article-supplied (GDELT), nominatim = online geocoder, title = local city/country lookup.
